pageTitle: Composite CN Calculator — SCS curve number and runoff · Mahfujur Rahman Joy
problem: Area-weighted SCS curve number (TR-55 / NEH-4) for every sub-catchment: paste a land-use table from Excel, get CN for AMC I, II and III, retention, initial abstraction, design-storm runoff and volume. Runs in your browser; files are never uploaded.
method: CN(II) = Σ(Aᵢ·CNᵢ) / ΣAᵢ (CNᵢ for the sub-catchment's soil group)
Q = (P − Ia)² / (P − Ia + S) for P > Ia, else 0; C = Q/P
V = Q·A·10 m³ (A in ha); with water excluded, A is the land area only
Soil textures map to hydrologic soil groups, open water can count at CN 100 or be left out, and the CN lookup for Bangladesh land-cover classes is editable.
data: Click a cell, then paste (Ctrl+V) a block copied from Excel. If your block starts with a header row, columns are matched by name in any order. Areas in hectares. Soil accepts a texture (e.g. Clay Loam) or a group letter A–D. CN lookup values are TR-55 analogues.

samples.label: Three built-in sample rows (Catchment 1–3), shown on first load
